name: trait TrustedRandomAccess : TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce
rule: After `self.__iterator_get_unchecked(idx)` is called on a `TrustedRandomAccess` iterator, only `Clone::clone`, `Iterator::size_hint`, `DoubleEndedIterator::next_back`, `ExactSizeIterator::len`, `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked`, and `TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size` may be called on that iterator, any new clones of it, or values resulting from any successive coercions of it to supertypes.
